drawings.description: feuillet de dessins, sans texte. Trois rangées de disques coupés par des cordes (droites ou arcs), parfois concourantes en un point marqué, une région parfois hachurée ; sous chaque disque ou groupe de disques réuni par une accolade, un petit graphe : un point, deux points, un segment, trois points, un segment et un point, un chemin à trois sommets, un triangle — apparemment le graphe dont les sommets sont les cordes et les arêtes leurs croisements. Plusieurs dessins sont marqués « ok » de sa main (le disque à trois cordes concourantes au-dessus d'un segment, le disque au triangle hachuré au-dessus du triangle, avec en variante « ou » un disque à cordes concourantes) ; sous une rangée de disques à quatre cordes parallèles, un « ? ». En bas à droite, des lignes brisées épaisses
drawings.kind: page of disks cut by chords, with their crossing graphs
drawings.notes: Redrawn disk by disk from a fresh crop of p. 9 (issue 128), 1 unit = 1.8 mm. Each disk is an ellipse fitted to his outline; every straight chord is clipped to that ellipse, so that it ends exactly on it, and where a disk carries a marked point the chords are drawn through that one point; the short curved chords (caps) are drawn as curves whose ends lie on the outline; heavy segments are drawn between the computed crossings of their chords (the X of the 7th disk of row 1, the two disks with a heavy middle bar and the ok disk of row 3), and the hatched triangle of row 1 between the crossings of its three chords. Row 1: one chord, two chords, X through a point (ok), three parallel chords and the disk with three caps (joined by a brace, three points ringed), the disk with a point and a cap (segment and point ringed), the X with a heavy bar and a third chord (ok, path of three vertices), the hatched triangle (ok, triangle), and "(ou" a disk with three chords through a point. Row 2: four parallel chords (outer two curved), three chords and a small cap, four caps (brace, four points, "?"); four disks with two chords through a point and caps, the last with a stroke rising from it (brace; segment and two points). Row 3: two pairs of chords through two points (ok; two segments); a disk with three chords, a curved fourth and a hatched region, and two disks with two chords and a heavy cross bar (brace; path of three vertices and a point); the ok disk with four chords and its heavy path (path of four vertices); the thick broken line at the bottom right and the strokes near it (a heavy stroke from the last graph, faint pencil strokes). Left out: small ticks where he starts an outline or a chord, an ink blot in the last disk of row 2 and a smudge under the ou-variant. Still differs: the outlines are ellipses (some of his are rounder at a corner); the hatched region of the first disk of row 3 is a reading of loose zigzag strokes (it could also be a scribbling-out). Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Revised 2026-11-09 after Michel's check (#136): yes, as redrawn; the region of the second disk of row 3 is hatched (a hatched polygon bounded by the three chords and the curved fourth side), not scribbled out; ok.

drawings.description: feuillet de dessins de la même famille que la page 9 : disques coupés de cordes, une région triangulaire ou quadrangulaire hachurée, trois marqués « OK », des variantes introduites par « ou » ; sous eux les graphes : un triangle, un point, un tripode épais en « Y », un carré, un triangle surmonté d'un segment, un rectangle coupé d'une diagonale, un triangle à point intérieur. À droite, deux axes fléchés en équerre et, dans l'angle, des courbes qui se croisent et deux disques coupés d'arcs
drawings.kind: page of disks cut by chords, with their graphs, and crossing curves
drawings.notes: Redrawn from a fresh crop of p. 11 (issue 128), 1 unit = 1.8 mm. Each disk is an ellipse fitted to his outline; every chord is clipped to it, so that it ends exactly on it; chords through a marked point are drawn through that one point; hatched regions and heavy segments are bounded by the computed crossings of their chords; two chords that he bends where they cross another (first disk, and the disk in the middle of row 2) are drawn as two straight pieces meeting on that chord. Top row: the disk with three chords and a hatched triangle (and a cap at the bottom), "ou" a small disk with three chords through a point; the OK disk with three verticals and a horizontal chord heavy between the outer verticals (dots at the ends of the horizontal, small circles at the ends of the middle vertical); the OK disk with four chords and a hatched quadrilateral; the ok disk with three chords, a hatched triangle, a heavy chord and a heavy part, "ou" a small disk with chords through a point. Graphs: triangle, point, the thick tripod Y, square, triangle with a segment on top. Row 2: the disk with a hatched bow tie; the OK disk, hatched and overdrawn with heavy zigzags, drawn as four chords with the region between the two long diagonals hatched up to the right-hand vertical; "ou ( ... )" with two small disks (crossing chords with a dark centre; four chords through a point); the disk with three chords, one bent, and a hatched triangle. Bottom: the rectangle with a diagonal, the triangle with an inner point. Right: the two arrowed axes at right angles (the vertical one drawn in several strokes, one arrow drawn on each), the upper disk cut by three chords and two arcs, the lower closed curve with the arcs crossing it, the long curves and lines crossing the region, two arrowheads as on the page. Left out: the struck b-like sign by the tripod and the zigzag between the rectangle and the triangle, small crosses and ticks at chord ends, a small squiggle between the two small disks. Still differs: the inner structure of the scribbled OK disk of row 2 is a reading (the zigzags may be a scribbling-out rather than hatching); the dark centres of the two small disks are drawn as a hatched quadrilateral and a point; the crossing curves at the right are read stroke by stroke, not as a figure. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, un dessin : un disque coupé de deux cordes horizontales $E_1$ (en haut) et $E_2$ (en bas) ; au-dessus de $E_1$, la calotte $\Sigma_1^+$, et une accolade à droite réunit tout ce qui est sous $E_1$ : $\Sigma_1^-$ ; sous $E_2$, la calotte $\Sigma_2^+$, et une accolade à gauche réunit tout ce qui est au-dessus de $E_2$ : $\Sigma_2^-$
drawings.kind: disk cut by two chords, with caps and braces
drawings.notes: Disk cut by two horizontal chords E_1 (top) and E_2 (bottom); the cap Sigma_1^+ above E_1, a brace on the right gathering all below E_1 (Sigma_1^-); the cap Sigma_2^+ under E_2, a brace on the left gathering all above E_2 (Sigma_2^-). A struck label above E_1 and the struck words around are left out.

drawings.description: à droite de « $\mathbb{P}(X)$ » et de « $O\subset\mathbb{P}(X)$ », un croquis à main levée : un petit disque d'où partent des rayons (cinq traits issus de son centre, dont trois dépassent le bord), traversé par une longue droite presque verticale, épaisse au-dessus du centre ; du disque montent des boucles en pétales, et en haut une grande boucle que croisent deux traits obliques.
drawings.kind: free-hand sketch: small disc with radii, a vertical line and petal loops
drawings.notes: Free-hand ink sketch, redrawn stroke by stroke. The small disc (ellipse) and five strokes from its centre, all drawn from the one centre point: to the upper left and to the upper right (heavy) beyond the rim, to the lower left, to the lower right beyond the rim (hook at its end), and downwards (the continuation of the long line). The long nearly vertical line: thin from the top, heavy from above the disc down to the centre. Loops: a narrow one along the heavy part of the line; a petal from the top of the disc to a tip at the right and back; a tall loop rising from the disc and bending over to the right at the top; an oblique stroke from the line up to the top of that loop; a long oblique stroke falling to the right across the loop, with a short parallel stroke at its end; a small hook and a short curve inside the tall loop; at the right a heavy stroke with a small bar at its top, ending in a hook near the disc. Left out: the letters of « P(X) » that run into the crop at the left. Still differs: the loops are a reading of overlapping free strokes, and their order and joins are approximate; the heavy bottom of the rim is drawn as a heavy arc. The note of the transcription says « aux rayons marqués, d'où partent des boucles en pétales »: agreed. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au bas de la feuille, trois croquis à main levée : à gauche un polygone à six côtés dont deux côtés consécutifs, en bas, sont repassés d'un trait épais, avec à son angle inférieur gauche un petit cercle et un enchevêtrement de traits fins ; au milieu une ligne brisée épaisse en « V » ouvert, doublée de traits fins ; à droite une ellipse traversée de six courbes à peu près verticales.
drawings.kind: three free-hand sketches: polygon with heavy sides, heavy broken line, ellipse crossed by curves
drawings.notes: Three free-hand ink sketches at the foot of the sheet. Left: a six-sided polygon; its two lower sides are heavy and meet at one vertex, the upper right corner and the lower part of the right side are gone over heavily; at its lower left corner a small circle and thin strokes (two long obliques, a thin triangle below, a curve). Middle: a heavy broken line of two segments, continued by a lighter third rising to the right, and thin strokes doubling it (two from its left end, two falling from its right end). Right: an ellipse crossed by six roughly vertical curves, ends on or near the outline, and a thin stroke from the broken line to the ellipse. Left out: nothing struck. Still differs: the thin tangle at the lower left of the polygon is a reading of overlapping strokes; the curves in the ellipse are approximate. The transcription's note (« un polygone et des lignes brisées épaisses, et une ellipse traversée de courbes ») agrees. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, un petit croquis : trois points $x$ (en bas), $y$ et $z$ (en haut), avec des flèches $x\to y$, $x\to z$ et deux traits croisés
drawings.notes: As on the page: z at the upper left, y at the upper right, x at the bottom, three small points (above the middle, by y, above x). Towards z, two arrows (a thin one from the lower middle, a heavy one with a doubled head from the middle); towards y, two arrows (a thin one from the lower middle, a heavy shorter one); two heavy strokes, at the lower left and at the lower right, across the pair of directions (the crossed strokes), and a short dash in the middle. Doubled strokes are drawn once each. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, en oblique, sous le mot « diagramme » : un segment entre deux gros points, et le long du segment la légende « $\Sigma^{-}\supset E\subset\Sigma^{+}$ » ; au-dessus du segment, un signe biffé.
drawings.kind: segment between two points, with its legend (margin, oblique)
drawings.notes: As on the page: an oblique segment rising to the right between two heavy points, and along it, below, the legend Sigma^- contains E contained in Sigma^+, each sign placed where he wrote it and turned along the segment. The struck sign above the segment (a scribbled-out blot) is left out, as is the word « diagramme » of the marginal note, which the transcription gives. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: sous « qu'on exprime par un diagramme », un segment horizontal portant trois points marqués, ses deux extrémités et son milieu, et dessous la légende « $\Sigma_{1}^{+}\supset E_{1}\hookrightarrow\Sigma_{12}\hookleftarrow E_{2}\hookrightarrow\Sigma_{2}^{+}$ ».
drawings.kind: segment with three marked points and its legend
drawings.notes: As on the page: a segment, rising slightly to the right, drawn through its three marked points (the two ends and the middle; the middle point is computed on the segment), and the legend below it, as the transcription reads it (the first sign is written like the others on the page but read as an inclusion sign there). Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again. Revised 2026-11-11 after Michel's check (#143): the first sign of the legend is a hooked arrow, written like the others, not a subset sign.
drawings.disagreement: Michel, #143: the first sign of the legend is a hooked arrow, written like the others, not a subset sign.

drawings.description: page sans texte : croquis au crayon d'une même opération de collage en volume — un disque vu en perspective relié par un tube court à une feuille rectangulaire ; un petit cercle traversé d'un trait entre deux arcs ; un grand rectangle à qui une bande est attachée par le haut ; une feuille en perspective portant deux petits cylindres dressés. En haut à droite, à l'encre, le trait vertical à extrémités recourbées du premier croquis de la page 53
drawings.kind: page of pencil sketches of a gluing in volume
drawings.notes: Faint pencil, redrawn at its places: a disk seen in perspective (two offset ellipses, the near rim heavy where he inked it) joined by a short tube (two lines, small rings at its ends) to a sheet standing behind it (its top edge and right edge) with a rectangular piece below the tube (heavy stroke at its upper left); a small circle crossed by a stroke between two arcs; a large rectangle with a band (two verticals and a U) attached at its top, its sides joined at the bottom to the sheet below; a sheet in perspective carrying two small upright cylinders, with the strokes of its edges as drawn; at the top right, in ink, the two small curled marks (from p. 53) and the faint stroke between them. Faint doublings reduced to one stroke. Still differs: the edges of the lower sheet are a reading of overlapping faint strokes. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, un cercle portant vingt et un points, sept pleins et quatorze évidés, inégalement espacés ; légende en dessous : « $S''$ \uncertain{marqué} \ill{} ».
drawings.kind: circle carrying full and open points
drawings.notes: A circle (drawn as an ellipse fitted to his outline) carrying 21 points, each placed on the outline at the direction where he drew it: 7 full and 14 open. Clockwise from the top: open, open, open, full, full, open, full, open, open, open, open, full (at the bottom), open, open, open, open, full, full, open, open, full. The legend under the circle is not redrawn (the transcription gives it). Disagreement in part with the transcription's note (« une vingtaine de points »): 21 are counted here. Still differs: which points are full is a reading in three places (the grey point at the lower left, drawn open; the two points at the left, of which the lower is drawn full and the upper open), and one or two of the small open points at the bottom could be counted differently. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again. Revised 2026-11-11 after Michel's check (#142): the drawing is right against the transcription.
drawings.disagreement: The transcription reads « About twenty, with another full/open split »; the page has 21: 7 full, 14 open (the grey point at the lower left drawn open) (Michel, #142: the drawing is right).

drawings.description: sous le texte, un grand cercle tracé à la main, sans aucune marque.
drawings.notes: A large circle drawn free-hand in one stroke, with no mark on it or in it; redrawn as a closed curve through points read on his outline (it is slightly flattened at the upper left). The small overlap where the stroke closes, at the lower right, is not drawn. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, un cercle traversé de trois cordes verticales parallèles, d'extrémités notées $a_{1}$, $b$, $a_{2}$ en haut et $a_{1}'$, $b'$, $a_{2}'$ en bas.
drawings.kind: circle with three parallel chords, ends labelled
drawings.notes: A circle (an ellipse fitted to his outline) cut by three vertical chords, each drawn between its two computed points on the outline; the ends are labelled a_1, b, a_2 above and a_1', b', a_2' below, outside the circle, as on the page. On the page the middle chord overshoots the outline slightly at both ends and the outline is open at the top by the letter b; neither is reproduced. The transcription's note says « à droite »: the figure is at the left of the text, in the margin, and the mark says so. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again. Revised 2026-11-11 after Michel's check (#143): the drawing is right against the transcription.
drawings.disagreement: The note of the transcription places the figure « à droite »; on the page it is at the left of the text. The transcription reads « At the right, as in the note »; the page has At the left, in the margin (Michel, #143: the drawing is right).

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, un arc de cercle aux deux extrémités marquées d'un point, la moitié supérieure repassée d'un trait épais.
drawings.kind: arc with two marked ends, upper half heavy
drawings.notes: An arc, concave to the right, from a point at the upper right to a point at the lower left; its upper half is gone over heavily. The thin and the heavy part are drawn through the same points and join at one point. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en tête à gauche, un croquis au crayon repassé à l'encre : deux lobes accolés, marqués « bi » et « bi », joints par un trait vertical épais dont les extrémités portent chacune une flèche courbe.
drawings.kind: two lobes glued along an edge (bi, bi)
drawings.notes: Two lobes in pencil, side by side, each marked « bi », meeting at a narrow waist; in ink, a heavy vertical stroke across the waist, with at its top a short curved arrow (concave upwards, head at the right) and at its foot a short curved arrow (head at the left). The vertical stroke is drawn between the middles of the two arrows. Left out: the pencil doublings of the right lobe and the faint stroke that runs on from the foot of the waist to the lower right. Still differs: the lobes are smooth curves through points read on his outlines; the two curved arrows are schematic. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en tête à droite, un croquis au crayon repassé à l'encre : deux lobes marqués « mon » et « bi », séparés par une bande que bordent deux traits parallèles (un troisième la partage) ; en haut de la bande deux flèches épaisses de sens contraires, l'une au-dessus de l'autre, et de même en bas, courbes.
drawings.kind: two lobes joined by a band (mon, bi)
drawings.notes: Two lobes in pencil, « mon » at the left and « bi » at the right, joined by a band: two pencil strokes bound it and a third divides it. In ink, at the top of the band, two heavy arrows one above the other, the upper pointing right and the lower pointing left, joined at the right by a short stroke; at the foot of the band two curved heavy arrows, the upper with its head at the left, the lower with its head at the right. Left out: pencil doublings of the outlines. Still differs: the lobes are smooth curves through points read on his outlines; the arrows are schematic. The transcription's note speaks of « une double flèche en haut et en bas »: on the page each is a pair of opposite arrows, as the mark says. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again. Revised 2026-11-11 after Michel's check (#143): the drawing is right against the transcription.
drawings.disagreement: The transcription reads « A double arrow, as in the note »; the page has A pair of opposite arrows, one above the other (Michel, #143: the drawing is right).

drawings.description: au milieu de la feuille, un croquis au crayon repassé à l'encre : deux lobes marqués « mon » et « mon », séparés par une bande à deux traits parallèles, avec en haut de la bande deux flèches épaisses de sens contraires, l'une au-dessus de l'autre.
drawings.kind: two lobes joined by a band (mon, mon)
drawings.notes: Two lobes in pencil, both marked « mon », joined by a band bounded by two pencil strokes; in ink, at the top of the band, two heavy arrows one above the other, the upper pointing right, the lower pointing left. Nothing at the foot of the band. Left out: a small ink tick by the right-hand « mon ». Still differs: the lobes are smooth curves through points read on his outlines; the arrows are schematic. The note of the transcription says « une double flèche au-dessus »: a pair of opposite arrows. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en bas à droite, au crayon, un cercle que coupe le bord de la feuille, avec des cordes inscrites : une corde tracée plusieurs fois entre deux points du cercle, et de chacun de ces points des traits qui descendent vers le bord de la feuille ; un point marqué sur le cercle à droite.
drawings.kind: pencil circle with inscribed chords, cut by the edge of the sheet
drawings.notes: Faint pencil. The upper part of a circle, cut off by the lower edge of the sheet (which is itself cut obliquely), drawn as an arc of a circle fitted to his outline; a chord between two points of the circle, drawn several times on the page and once here; from its left end a stroke down to the edge and a thin broken stroke by the outline; from its right end a stroke down to the left as far as the edge; a small point on the circle at the right. Every chord ends on the computed points of the circle. The writing that crosses the circle (the last formulas and « deux faces deviennent 2 » with its vertical stroke) belongs to the text and is not drawn. Still differs: the pencil doublings of the outline and of the chord (three or four strokes each) are reduced to one; the faint strokes near the outline at the right are left out. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.
